SELECT A.ITEMID , A.ITEM_NM , A.ITEMALIAS_NM , A.ITEMEXPLAN_DESC , A.DATATYPE_CD , (SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '102' AND CODE = A.DATATYPE_CD) AS DATATYPE_NM , (SELECT LGON_ID FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE TO_CHAR(USER_ID) = A.UPDATE_USERID) AS UPDATE_USERID ,(SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME,13,2) )as UPDATE_DATETIME , (SELECT LGON_ID FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE TO_CHAR(USER_ID) = A.FIRSTREG_USERID) AS FIRSTREG_USERID ,(SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME,7,2)||' '||SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME,9,2)||':'||SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME,11,2)||':'||SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME,13,2) )as FIRSTREG_DATETIME , A.ITEM_USE_YN , A.IFID ,B.USED_CNT FROM RULEITEM A LEFT JOIN (SELECT ITEMID, COUNT(DISTINCT RULEID) AS USED_CNT FROM (SELECT RULEID, SUBSTR(OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT WHERE DATATYPE_CD = 3 AND OBJECT_DATA LIKE '%' UNION ALL SELECT B.RULEID, SUBSTR(B.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(B.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT B WHERE B.DATATYPE_CD = 3 AND B.OBJECT_DATA LIKE '%' UNION ALL SELECT B.RULEID, B.RETURN_ITEMID AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM B) GROUP BY ITEMID) B ON A.ITEMID = B.ITEMID WHERE 1=1
AND A.IFID in( #{ifid}, 'IF00000000')
AND A.ITEM_USE_YN = #{itemUseYn}
AND A.ITEM_NM LIKE '%' || #{itemNm} || '%'
AND A.ITEMALIAS_NM LIKE '%' || #{itemAliasNm} || '%'
SELECT ITEMID ,ITEM_NM ,ITEMALIAS_NM ,ITEMEXPLAN_DESC ,DATATYPE_CD ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME ,ITEM_USE_YN ,FIRSTREG_USERID ,FIRSTREG_DATETIME FROM RULEITEM WHERE ITEMID = #{value}
SELECT ITEMID ,ITEMREF_CD ,ITEMREF_NM ,ITEMREFALIAS_NM ,ITEMREFEXPR_DESC ,UPDATE_USERID ,UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULEITEMREF WHERE ITEMID = #{value}
select RULEID from RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT where OBJECT_DATA = #{value} and DATATYPE_CD = 3
select RULEID from RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT where OBJECT_DATA = #{value} and DATATYPE_CD = 3
select RULEID ,RULE_NM ,RULE_STATE ,ACTIVATE_YN from RULE where ruleid = #{value}
